[Section] Experiments
[source_id=49] In this section, we first describe our datasets and experimental setup. We then instantiate our approach with Markov and DMV-structured syntax models, and report results on POS tagging and dependency grammar induction respectively. Lastly, we analyze the learned latent embeddings.
